notes: Original Study 2 reports r = -0.75 across 12 aggregated data points on p. 11; no p is printed for that correlation. Original method reports 213 participants whereas results report 219; neither is used as the correlation n. Replication Study 2 is the Prolific sample, not MTurk (MTurk r = -.87, p = .003). Prolific correlation is based on aggregated t-values, not 776 independent participant pairs; its aggregate n is left null because not explicitly printed as n. Figure 1 describes four information manipulations for three technologies. The replication raw PDF text encodes minus signs as leading 2 and less-than signs as backslashes; es and p values restore these mathematical glyphs, while quotations retain frozen raw text. Negative direction is explicitly confirmed in the surrounding prose. Replication title and DOI verified in retrieved full paper; repository cover gives 2022 publication and article copyright is 2021. Authors report overall successful replication, with a low-benefit-condition exception; the target aggregate correlation is narratively supported.
